status: AUTHOR ONLY; no compile/link, CUDA target, solver, decoder, production edit, Git or SHA operation for this fixture.
CLI: --source ORIGINAL132.csv --cpu ACTUAL_CPU_POINTS.csv --out FRESH_DIR; compile the cpp by absolute path with the current authoritative GPU Debug headers and production object closure. Required source is outputs/upl_material_return_CPU_result_r1/points.csv; required actual CPU reference is outputs/upl_material_shared_CPU_r1/result/points.csv plus its completion. This is not standalone math: the current compiled JSphGpuSimple_ker production object must supply the real wrappers.
scope: Exactly71 retained cases, one actual normal fluid slot and two protected tails. Per case real CteInteractionUpTStep uploads original eight float material constants, MaterialReturn=1 and original float-radian psi. The old strainsoftening constant alternates independently between0/1, including complementary Pre/Cor selections. Actual cusphs::ComputeStepSymplecticPre and ComputeStepSymplecticCor each run once for that case. No private copied integration kernel or host Return substitutes for the device wrapper.
inputs: Given trial effective stress is stored by explicit named native fields; sigma rate, v, Ace, Arc and gravity are0; dt=2^-10, Pre dtm=2^-11 and Cor dtm/dt=2^-11/2^-10. Positive rho2100, min700/max3000, np1/npb0, no shifting/InOut/floating/NoPen/J-feedback. Cor receives the unchanged original trial/old history, matching production's restored predictor history. This is not a spatial solver or a trajectory and does not exercise generation of trial stresses from nonzero Rsigma.
success_checks: Actual CPU CSV IDs/input_bits/path/branch/status are bound to shared Load.54 ordinary cases per stage must match six stresses within the sum of the original8192eps tensor budgets. Pre saved kappa must equal original float bits; Cor saved kappa must equal actual CPU saved-float bits, a deliberately stringent same-input adapter check rather than a spatial error bound. Existing kplasticdk is unchanged in Pre and adds fmaxf(new-old,0) in Cor. Zero kinematics and all original input records remain unchanged.
failure_checks: Expected5 Invalid and12 ApexNeeded cases per stage must set exactly1u<<expected_status and leave all native point outputs (vel/rho, sigma, kappa, kplasticdk, movements) at their distinct preloaded canaries; code is always unchanged. NonConverged has no natural witness and is explicitly uncovered. The test cannot distinguish successful Elastic/Radial classes from status bits alone; their labels are the independent CPU expectation.
tails: Two out-of-range points protect every defined output scalar and both trailing flag words; each stage also checks all3 records of each of7 protected input arrays. Expected142 wrapper calls,108 success history checks,34 failure-write checks,284 output tail checks and2982 protected input record checks. Field comparisons avoid native tensor/Result padding.
outputs: Fresh steps.csv has142 actual stage rows and native output state-bit descriptors; completion.json records real wrapper counts and differences only on success. No legacy default/OFF bit-equivalence is invented: a retained actual wrapper-stage control is not currently part of this fixture.
limits: The fixture tests device wrapper/adapter value semantics and failure flags, not the JSphGpu host's scalar allocation, exception/cleanup path or complete Pre/Cor acceptance timing. Those require separate actual host-path witnesses. No apex cap, new public plastic admission, spatial accuracy, Release parity or full simulation acceptance follows.
execution_requires: Root full-read of source/note, current production GPU adapter and successful current object closure, then separate authorization for one compile/link and one memcheck. Existing outputs are never overwritten.
